source.title: Arizona Secretary of State — 2014 U.S. House results
source.notes: All nine independent House district contests; votes and percentages belong to each selected district. Official district totals and complete candidate rosters checked against House Clerk statistics. District turnout is N/A unless an explicitly district-specific source is retained. The final court-certified CD2 recount supersedes Ron Barber and Martha McSally original-canvas/Clerk totals; other candidate rows are retained unchanged. Live official PDF requests were blocked. Reviewed indexed official tables and retained CSVs are identified separately from original PDF binaries.  Checksum covers retained file: data/raw/us-house/2014-house-transcription.csv.

additional_sources.title: U.S. House Clerk — 2014 official election statistics
additional_sources.notes: Original official PDF retained. Every Arizona House candidate is matched by district, reported total and source-name alias. The 2014 publication predates the CD2 recount; those two values are explicitly superseded by the court-certified recount. Checksum covers retained file: data/raw/us-house/clerk-2014.pdf.

additional_sources.title: Arizona court-certified 2014 Congressional District 2 recount
additional_sources.notes: Retained indexed court-order table: Ron Barber 14,677 Cochise + 94,870 Pima = 109,547; Martha McSally 21,737 Cochise + 87,977 Pima = 109,714. Replaces only these two candidates; original canvass and Clerk values retained for audit. Hash identifies the indexed text extract. Checksum covers retained file: data/raw/us-house/2014-recount-indexed.txt.
